steps.title: Select Actor Mode and Scope Requirements
steps.detail: Decide whether the OAuth app will operate on behalf of the authorizing user (actor=user) or as its own bot identity (actor=app). Determine required scopes (read, write).
steps.agentHelp: Generate configuration templates and specify authorize URL parameters including actor mode.

steps.title: Create OAuth Application in Linear Console
steps.detail: Navigate to Linear API settings and create a new application or submit an app manifest.
steps.agentHelp: Generate app manifest JSON pre-populated with callback URLs and scope definitions.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Client Credentials
steps.detail: Input absolute HTTP/HTTPS redirect URIs (up to 32) and securely capture the Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.agentHelp: Draft environment variable structure and store secrets safely in local environment files.

steps.title: Implement PKCE OAuth 2.0 Flow and Token Refresh
steps.detail: Implement Authorization Code grant with PKCE (S256 code challenge). Support access token expiration (24h) and background refresh logic with 30-minute grace period handling.
steps.agentHelp: Write full PKCE authorization code exchange and auto-refresh logic with handling for refresh token replay limits.

steps.title: Set Distribution to Public
steps.detail: Update app settings or manifest field `distribution` to `public` so external Linear workspace admins can connect.
steps.agentHelp: Update app manifest file to set distribution=public.

steps.title: Submit for Directory Listing (Optional)
steps.detail: If directory visibility is desired, prepare color/monochrome icons and showcase screenshots, then submit via email to integrations@linear.app.
steps.agentHelp: Format asset metadata and draft directory submission request email.

steps.title: Customer Workspace Admin Approval
steps.detail: Prompt customer Linear workspace admins to complete the OAuth consent flow to install the application in their workspace.
steps.agentHelp: Construct the exact authorization URL parameterized with workspace hints and state tokens.

gotchas.title: Refresh Token 30-Minute Grace Period
gotchas.detail: Linear permits replaying refresh token requests within a 30-minute grace period to prevent race conditions during network failures.
gotchas.mitigation: Do not invalidate new refresh tokens immediately if a duplicate refresh request occurs within 30 minutes.

gotchas.title: GraphQL Query Complexity Limits
gotchas.detail: OAuth apps are capped at 2,000,000 GraphQL complexity points per hour and 10,000 points per individual query in addition to the 5,000 requests/hour limit.
gotchas.mitigation: Track rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Requests-Remaining) and avoid over-fetching deeply nested GraphQL relations.

gotchas.title: Workspace Admin Consent Requirement
gotchas.detail: Installing third-party integrations into a Linear workspace requires workspace admin privileges.
gotchas.mitigation: Ensure your onboarding flow explicitly instructs users that a Linear workspace admin must authorize the integration.

gotchas.title: App Default Distribution is Private
gotchas.detail: Newly created OAuth apps default to private distribution and cannot be authorized by users in other Linear workspaces.
gotchas.mitigation: Set distribution to public in app settings or manifest before launching to external users.
